subject: Citywide Inclusion Specialist and Adaptive Recreation
overview: The committee met with parents and the Recreation Director to discuss Resolution 25-027 regarding programs for youth with disabilities and the creation of a citywide inclusion specialist. Members and advocates explored regional partnerships for adaptive recreation and the development of a comprehensive accessibility master plan.

items.title: Public Testimony on Accessibility and Inclusion
items.summary: Parents and advocates proposed creating a citywide inclusion specialist role to facilitate accessibility across all municipal services and private businesses, arguing that the position should not be housed exclusively within the Recreation Department. Speakers also noted significant vacancies on the Commission for Persons with Disabilities and the need to update the city's aging ADA transition plan.

items.title: Committee Deliberation and Outcomes
items.summary: Tabled the resolution for further discussion during the budget cycle and directed the Recreation Department to establish a parent working group to help design future programming. The committee proposed forming a multi-departmental task force involving the Mayor's office and the DEI department to draft a citywide inclusion specialist job description.

items.title: Recreation Department Adaptive Programming
items.summary: Director Kevin Bailey outlined a Tri-City regional partnership with Malden and Somerville to rotate adaptive sporting and social events to ensure sufficient participation and resources. He requested additional administrative support for his department to allow specialized staff more time to implement therapeutic recreation.
